definitions: To disqualify oneself from a legal case or other proceeding due to a potential conflict of interest or bias.
To remove oneself from participation to avoid a conflict of interest.
examples: The judge decided to recuse oneself from the high-profile case.
She had to recuse oneself due to a family connection.
It is important to recuse oneself if there is any appearance of impropriety.
pastTenses: recused oneself (past simple), has/have recused oneself (present perfect), recused oneself (past perfect)
